verdict.rationale: Graphite documents a GitHub App install path (graphite-docs-9) enabling AI reviews with 'no configuration required' and reviews enabled 'in just a few clicks' (graphite-docs-18, graphite-docs-19), suggesting fast setup and automatic PR review. However, there is no explicit documentation confirming reviews post as native inline PR comments, and community evidence explicitly states GitLab is NOT supported (graphite-comm-4), contradicting half of the story's integration claim. Missing for 10: explicit inline-comment UI evidence, GitLab app support, and independent confirmation of 'minutes'-scale setup speed.
